title: Flex to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: Flex (NASDAQ: FLEX) has announced that members of its leadership team will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences: KeyBanc Industrials and Basic Materials Conference Date: Wednesday, May 27, 2026 Meetings only; no formal presentation or webcast Bank of America Global Technology Conference Date: Tuesday, June 2, 2026 Presentation time: 5:20 p.m. CT / 6:20 p.m. ET The live webcast presentation will be available on the Flex Investor Relations website at investors.flex.com . A replay of the webcast will be available on the investor relations website following the conclusion of the event. About Flex Flex (Reg. No. 199002645H) is the manufacturing partner of choice that helps leading brands design, build, and manage products that improve the world.
